results.snippet:

results.snippet:
# Opay Shares Fail to Trade After Raising $304 Million in US IPO

Shares of Opay Ltd., a Nigeria-focused payments platform, didn’t begin trading in New York as expected after the company raised $304 million in a US initial public offering priced at the bottom of the range.
